build.echo_set_note: Pick by team: Flower of Tinged Yearning for Unison teams, Rejuvenating Glow for Echo teams and general play. Launch-day guides rate the two close — neither wins everywhere.

echo_sets.name: Rejuvenating Glow
echo_sets.note: 15% ATK for the whole team, +10% ATK from Fallacy. Main Echo Fallacy grants +10% ER. HP% improves healing.
echo_sets.usage: best for Echo teams and general play

echo_sets.name: Flower of Tinged Yearning
echo_sets.note: 10% ATK for the whole team, 25% ATK with Unison. Formrender is a 3-cost Echo and the main Echo here, so this set runs 34311, with a Healing Bonus 4-cost alongside. Formrender adds +10% ER.

build.fast_path: Fast path (kit verified against the 3.8 release client and launch-day guides): Lullaby + a 5-piece set — Flower of Tinged Yearning with Formrender in a 34311 layout for Unison teams (Formrender is a 3-cost Echo, so it headlines the build), Rejuvenating Glow with Fallacy of No Return in a 43311 layout for Echo teams. Aim for a Healing Bonus 4-cost, Energy Regen 3-costs, HP% 1-costs, and 260% Energy Regen — her team ATK buff and Echo Skill crit buffs scale with Energy Regen above 190% and max out at 260%. Skill priority: Forte > Liberation > Intro > Basic ATK > Skill. Support rotation: Intro > Skill > BA1-4 > Forte > Liberation > Outro; hold Forte until Finale, use Echo before switching.

ranked_weapons.name: Lullaby
ranked_weapons.note: Her signature. Lv.90: 413 ATK, 77.0% Energy Regen. Passive, Dreamland Solace: Max HP +12%; casting her Liberation restores 8 Concerto Energy (once every 20s); healing grants the whole team Soothed Soul for 30s — while it lasts, gaining or triggering Unison grants +16% ATK for 7s, and healing gives the active Resonator +24% Echo Skill DMG for 6s.

ranked_weapons.name: Static Mist
ranked_weapons.note: 10-20% ATK to the next Resonator (R1, for team damage). Only 10% ATK applies to the next Resonator.

stat_priorities.note: Healing Bonus; HP% is the alternate. Her finishers convert excess Energy Regen into Crit, so Crit main stats are not the pick.
Energy Regen on both 3-costs — her buffs scale with Energy Regen above 190% and cap at 260%.
HP% on both; HP% improves healing.

profile.role_note: Support and healer. She heals the team, deals AoE damage, gathers enemies while channeling her Forte, and keeps healing through her Resonance Liberation. Her buffs apply in Unison and Echo teams; Lullaby's buffs do not apply outside them. Kit, sequences and her weapon's passive verified against the 3.8 release client and launch-day guides (Nov 12, 2026).

pull_verdict.verdict: Worth it if you run Unison or Echo teams: Lily is a universal-slot healer/support whose buffs are strongest in Unison and Echo Skill teams. Pull her if those are your teams or you lack a premium sustain. Skip or wait if Shorekeeper or Verina already cover you and you're saving for a future version. She is live now — Version 3.8 Phase 1 runs to Dec 3, 2026.
pull_verdict.verdict_label: Worth it — if you run Unison or Echo teams

pull_path.why: Dream Aroma stacks also grant 2% Crit Rate and 6% Crit DMG each while Cradle Lullaby is active — 8% / 24% at four stacks.
Dream Perfume gains, Concerto Energy from her Liberation, and faster Dreambell Chime — a smoother rotation.

sequences.verdict: S2 is the breakpoint — Dream Aroma stacks grant 2% Crit Rate and 6% Crit DMG each while Cradle Lullaby is active, so no signature weapon is needed for the crit-buff role. S3 is rotation comfort.
sequences.weapon_vs_dupes: Dupes before signature for the crit-buff role: chase S2 before Lullaby. Lullaby is the pick when you want its Energy Regen and team buffs in one slot.

teams_meta.note: Post-launch synergies (Prydwen's Lily guide, Nov 12, 2026) — Unison: Hsin and Suoming are her best partners. Echo Skill: Sigrika with Qiuyuan, with Lucilla as Qiuyuan's alternative. Galbrena can hold the Echo carry slot but is a step down: part of her damage is Heavy Attack damage, which Lily does not buff, and Shorekeeper fits her better. Almost no synergy: Phrolova — Lily's buffs apply only to the active Resonator, and Phrolova plays off-field. One consistency caveat: Unison teams do not reach full team CRIT Rate from her buffs until her S2, so Shorekeeper can feel steadier in Whimpering Wastes. Support packages: Echo S0R1: 25% AMP, 39% ATK, 10% CR, 20% CD, 24% ES Bonus; Echo S2R1: 25% AMP, 53% ATK, 18% CR, 44% CD, 24% ES Bonus; Unison S0R1: 25% AMP, 90% ATK (S6 Hsin 97%); Unison S2R1: 25% AMP, 90% ATK, 8% CR, 24% CD; General S0R0: 25% AMP, 39% ATK; General S2R0: 25% AMP, 53% ATK, 8% CR, 24% CD; S2R0 SK: 15% AMP, 65% ATK, 12.5% CR, 25% CD. AMP = damage amplification; ES = Echo Skill; SK = Shorekeeper.
